category: Brazilian reseller of resold Real-Debrid credentials (single product SKU, BRL)

free_tier.stated: None. The store sells fixed-term credentials; there is no free or trial product for Real-Debrid.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the underlying service is Real-Debrid, whose own host and file caps apply. The reseller adds none.

retention.stated: 30 days: 'Conta Oficial do Real-debrid Por 30 dias'. After that the credential expires unless renewed through the same seller.

egress.terms: The reseller publishes no traffic terms. The account carries whatever Real-Debrid grants, and Real-Debrid's own account-sharing enforcement applies to a credential that several buyers may hold.

interface_detail: The buyer receives Real-Debrid login credentials by email - 'voce recebera por email os dados, para utilizar direto no site do Real-debrid'. Everything after that is Real-Debrid's own web panel and API, not the reseller's.
tooling: Real-Debrid's API and the usual add-ons work with the credential, because it is a real Real-Debrid account. The buyer does not control the recovery email.
chaining: This is a payment rail, not a capability: it converts Pix-era Brazilian payment into a Real-Debrid session. It chains with any Stremio or torrent add-on exactly as a direct subscription would, with one extra failure point between the buyer and the service.

limits.value: Real-Debrid's own simultaneous-session rule; the reseller publishes none, and a resold credential is used from more than one address by construction

limits_note: The product page makes no promise about concurrency, IP or password. The only consumer protection named is 'Garantia 7 dias Satisfacao ou seu dinheiro de volta', which is shorter than the 30 days sold.
binding_note: The account is sold to multiple buyers from one registration, so the first failure at any real volume is the service noticing simultaneous sessions from different addresses, not a byte quota.
price_per_tb_month: BRL 24.90 per 30 days (USD 4.94 at 5.0383); not metered per TB

identity_cost.detail: A store account and an email address are enough to order: 'Envio Imediato - Entrega automatica em Segundos'. No CPF is requested on the product page; payment methods are not listed there, so the Pix path is unverified.

reliability_note: The buyer holds credentials registered by somebody else and cannot recover them: the recovery email is the seller's, the password can be rotated by the seller at any time, and Real-Debrid's own terms treat use from several addresses as grounds for a block. The 7-day guarantee is the entire recourse, against a 30-day product.
confidence_note: Price, term, delivery method, guarantee length and the email-credentials sentence were read on the vendor's product page. The payment methods and whether the same account is sold to several buyers are not stated there and remain unverified.

evidence.proved: 'R$ 24,90', 'Conta Oficial do Real-debrid Por 30 dias', 'Envio Imediato Entrega automatica em Segundos', 'Garantia 7 dias'
'Apos a confirmacao do pagamento voce recebera por email os dados, para utilizar direto no site do Real-debrid' - the buyer gets credentials, not a subscription in their own name
'Conta Premium Real-Debrid ( 1 Ano - 365 Dias ) - Oficial' at R$ 145,00, the annual SKU from the same seller

a Spanish-language user report of the enforcement side: 'si detectan que se usa simultaneamente desde 2 o mas IP diferentes os mandan correo de aviso y es motivo de baneo' - reported, not verified against Real-Debrid's own text

notes: The word 'Oficial' in the listing means 'a genuine Real-Debrid account' as opposed to a cracked or trial one; it does not mean the buyer becomes the account holder. Three other Brazilian storefronts - contasvip.com.br at R$ 25,00, mercadocontas.com.br at R$ 24,90 and premiumturbo.com.br with 30/90/365-day variants - carry the same product copy and the same guarantee sentence, which is the signature of one wholesale source behind several storefronts.

extras.fx: BRL to USD at 5.0383, Banco Central do Brasil PTAX dollar sale rate for 2026-10-22; local prices kept as stated
extras.direct_price_reported: Real-Debrid 30 days at EUR 4.00, listed identically by three third-party price guides; real-debrid.com itself was not read
